name: long-brief-retrieval
description: A ~3 KB task brief (team header, role, assignment in the middle, closing checklist) injects the stored gotcha its assignment names, once per session; a brief about something nobody wrote down injects nothing; the gotcha then leads the next session's start, with its summary.

notes.title: cmd /c mvnw.cmd from Git Bash builds nothing
notes.body: Running cmd /c mvnw.cmd from Git Bash exits 0 and the build never starts. Run ./mvnw instead.

notes.title: Cache eviction policy
notes.body: The cache uses LRU eviction with a 500 entry cap.

notes.title: Deploy steps
notes.body: Run install.py, then the hook setup for each harness.

notes.title: Database migration plan
notes.body: Migrations run in a transaction and are reversible.
